routes.reason: CA.4 owns classical Diophantine equations and elementary descent, and already receives the Markoff equation and its descent from PAPER-MARTIN-25 and PAPER-GHOSH-SARNAK-22. The Markoff–Hurwitz equation, its moves, the exceptional families, the passage to V(ℤ₊), Proposition 16 and the infinite descent are that kind of mathematics, and neither library has them.

The Part II ArithmeticDynamicsPartIIMarkoff was accepted through PAPER-MARTIN-25 and PAPER-GHOSH-SARNAK-22, and its design job is #1700. Orbit counting for the Markoff–Hurwitz moves (the free semigroup Λ, multiplicities, acceleration, the renewal equation, linearisation and Theorem 3) extends it naturally. No atlas stage mentions Markoff. The brief states Theorem 3 exactly and imports Theorem 13 from route 3. It has been amended with the corrected positivity argument (E1) and E10–E13.

A new Part II is justified. Neither pinned library nor any atlas stage has transfer operators, Ruelle–Perron–Frobenius theory, renewal theorems, Kato perturbation or the Schauder–Tychonoff theorem (both libraries and all layer texts were searched). PM.4 stops at the Gauss map, so the extension in its direction is right. No functional-analysis roadmap owns Kato perturbation or Schauder–Tychonoff, so supplying them here is acceptable. The brief states the six final theorems exactly and names its imports. It has been amended with E15–E17 and with the dependence of β₀ = β on E1.
